lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fábia | Lesson 22 -- Review -- What the Fee Covers

listenings.text: Well, the fee is the fee, you know, it is always the same. But this month there was more work, I think, with the new office and the people. So the invoice is a bit higher. It is normal, it happens sometimes. We can look at it together later, if you want.

Your monthly fee covers bookkeeping, payroll and your tax returns. However, this month we did additional work: we set up the payroll for twelve new employees in your new branch. Although the fee does not change, additional work has its own price. It is in item four of the engagement letter. However, from next month, their payroll is in the monthly fee.
